title: Outer state initialization
statement: For natural numbers $s,w,u,v,M$, let the outer state be the state initialized using $s$ and $w$, with its source code set to $u$, its target code set to $v$, and its midpoint set to $M$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the initialization state `setSt`, so its other register values cannot be described precisely.
